propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based) and Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based) have asymmetric test coverage from different hardening phases, creating gaps in both directions where shared behaviors are untested on one side

Data Center adapter lacks value-pinned characterization tests for create-path field values, sanitizer boundaries, identity label form, and probe branches, relying only on contract shape assertions and live harness coverage
Data Center adapter has not validated comment and description length convergence across multiple passes or documented the source of its comment character limit constant
The ticket-type field mapping is duplicated across adapters without a single-source guard, unlike status and priority maps which already have anti-regression assertions
Vacuous tests in the characterization suite do not clearly assert their intended contracts or are misnamed relative to what they actually pin
Cloud adapter's pagination, rate-limiting, and TLS validation tests lack equivalents in Data Center adapter despite both sharing related operational edge cases
